title: Listening: economic activities in Ethiopia
competency: Listen to a text and identify important details about economic activities.

keywords.def: Money that a person, family or country earns.
To give or add something (money, work, help) to a bigger total.
A large area of land covered with trees and plants.
A main area of economic activity, such as agriculture, mining or manufacturing.

en.text: Economic activities are the ways people earn a living: farming, planting, fishing, sewing, mining, manufacturing and more. Before listening, learn the key words: income is money earned, to contribute is to add to a bigger total, and a forest is a large area of trees. An economic sector is a main area of activity, like agriculture or energy.

am.text: የኢኮኖሚ እንቅስቃሴዎች ሰዎች ኑሯቸውን የሚመሩባቸው መንገዶች ናቸው፤ እርሻ፣ ዓሣ ማጥመድ፣ ማዕድን ማውጣት፣ ልብስ መስፋት። ገቢ የሚገኝ ገንዘብ ነው።

screens.title: What work is this?
screens.ask: A farmer ploughs a field with oxen. Which economic activity is this?
screens.after: Farming. Ploughing with oxen is the first picture in Activity 1.2.

screens.title: Key words before listening
paras: average national income: the total income of a country divided by the number of people.
contributes: gives or adds something to a bigger total. "Agriculture contributes a large share of Ethiopia's income."
forest: a large area of land covered with trees and plants.
An economic sector is a main area of activity: agriculture, mining, fishing, forestry, energy, manufacturing.

Boys with rods at a lake
A woman at a sewing machine

screens.why: Each picture shows the work named.
screens.clue: What tool is each person using?

screens.ask: "Agriculture ___ a large share of Ethiopia's income." (adds to)
screens.why: To contribute is to add to a bigger total; with "Agriculture" (singular) add -s.

screens.text: Which word means a large area of land covered with trees?
A country earns 1,000 million Birr and has 10 million people. What is its average national income per person?
screens.why: Average national income = total income ÷ number of people = 1,000 million ÷ 10 million = 100 Birr.
screens.clue: Divide the total by the number of people.

en.text: The listening text describes Ethiopia's main economic sectors. Agriculture employs about 80 percent of workers and is the most promising resource. Marketing, processing and export depend on it. Forest products are logs for construction; fishing is in freshwater lakes only, because Ethiopia has no sea coast; energy comes mainly from waterpower and forests. Listen for these details.

am.text: ግብርና 80 በመቶ የሚሆነውን ሠራተኛ ይዟል። ኢትዮጵያ የባሕር ዳርቻ ስለሌላት ዓሣ ማጥመድ በሐይቆች ብቻ ነው። ዋና የኃይል ምንጮች የውኃ ኃይልና ደን ናቸው።

screens.title: Where do Ethiopians fish?
screens.ask: Ethiopia has no sea coast. Where does its fishing take place?
screens.after: In freshwater lakes and rivers. Ethiopia's fisheries are entirely freshwater.

screens.title: Notes from the listening text
paras: Your teacher reads the listening text aloud. These notes give its key details.
Agriculture is the country's most promising resource. It employs about 80 percent of the labour force.
Many other activities depend on agriculture: marketing, processing and export of farm products.
Forest products are mainly logs used in construction.
Fisheries are entirely freshwater and a small part of the economy.
Waterpower and forests are Ethiopia's main energy sources.
Manufacturing includes food and beverage products. Mining is the process of getting minerals.
screens.note: The full listening text is in the teacher's guide.

screens.title: Key word
defs: A main area of economic activity, such as agriculture, mining or manufacturing.

screens.text: Activity 1.3: match each activity with its description.
pairs: It includes food and beverage products.
It is a process of getting minerals.
It is being practised in freshwater lakes.
It employs 80 percent of the labor force.
It uses waterpower and forests as main sources.
screens.clue: Which description names minerals, lakes, workers, power?

screens.ask: Forest products are mainly logs used in ___.
screens.why: Forest logs are used for building.

screens.text: Activity 1.4 Q5: which are Ethiopia's main energy sources?
screens.why: Energy "uses waterpower and forests as main sources".

screens.text: Activity 1.6: why would many people rank agriculture "Most Important"?
opts: It employs about 80 percent of workers and other activities depend on it
It is a small part of the economy
screens.ans: It employs about 80 percent of workers and other activities depend on it
screens.clue: How many people work in it?

screens.text: A student says: "Fishing should be Ethiopia's biggest sector." Which detail from the listening argues against this?
opts: Fisheries are only freshwater and a small part of the economy
screens.ans: Fisheries are only freshwater and a small part of the economy
screens.why: Without a sea coast, fishing is limited to lakes and rivers, so it stays a small part of the economy.
